paragraphs: Echodyne designs, manufactures and delivers commercial radar systems built around a technology it calls MESA. Its customers are systems suppliers, integrators and end users in defense, government, critical infrastructure protection, C-UAS and UAS/AAM markets in more than 40 countries. MESA stands for metamaterials electronically scanned array, and the company holds global patents on those radar architectures.

The radars are aimed at counter-UAS and multi-domain missions, where the company says they improve safety and security outcomes. Configurations range from fixed installations to rapid setup portable kits, and Echodyne describes MIL-STD reliability at COTS availability. The company has announced an Android Team Awareness Kit plugin that lets users configure, control and visualize data from its radars within ATAK.
Radars are manufactured outside Seattle, Washington, in the United States. Echodyne is AS9100 and ISO 9001 certified. AS9100 is a standardized quality management system for the aerospace industry.

quote.text: Invent, design, deliver, & evolve radar systems that shatter decades of cost-for-performance barriers.
